Brand identity

Vimalife

A wellness brand built on movement and balance

Client
Vimalife
Year
2025
Role
Creative Lead
Scope
Logo · Brand Guidelines · Creative Direction · Signage · Merchandise · Social Media

I developed the visual identity for Vimalife, a wellness brand centred around movement, balance and community.

From the logo and brand guidelines to studio signage, merchandise and social media, I created a flexible visual system designed to feel calm, contemporary and recognisable across every touchpoint.

01   The idea

Elevation in
a single mark

The identity began with a simple idea: movement towards something better.

I developed a geometric symbol using interlocking lines to represent elevation, balance and strength. Paired with a widely spaced wordmark, the logo feels minimal yet distinctive.

The aim was to create an identity that reflected both the physical and mindful sides of wellness, without relying on typical fitness branding.

02   Creative direction

Grounded, aspirational,
community-driven

I built the creative direction around natural textures, earthy colours and warm, welcoming spaces.

A palette of muted greens, terracotta and warm neutrals creates a grounded foundation, while brighter accents introduce energy and movement.

The moodboard established a visual direction that balances calmness with motivation, shaping how the brand would look and feel across different applications.

03   Spaces and signage

Calm from
the street in

I explored how the identity could translate into physical spaces, from exterior signage to reception branding and interior wall details.

Minimal typography, subtle logo applications and natural materials help create an environment that feels welcoming, balanced and true to the brand’s wellness philosophy.

04   Merchandise

Branded
with restraint

I extended the identity across apparel and wellness essentials, including hoodies, caps, bags, yoga mats and towels.

Rather than making the branding the focal point, I explored subtle applications through embroidery, debossing and print, allowing each item to feel like a natural extension of the brand.

05   Social and promotion

Community,
in the feed

I brought the visual identity into social media and promotional materials, including Instagram layouts, class schedules and carousel posts.

Consistent typography, colours and layouts create a recognisable presence while keeping the content clear, approachable and easy to engage with.
